scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wudao/core build && pnpm --filter @wudao/providers build && pnpm --filter @wudao/browser build && pnpm --filter @wudao/server build && pnpm --filter @wudao/web build && pnpm --filter wudao-harness build && pnpm --filter @wudao/slack build && pnpm --filter @wudao/evals build
scripts.check: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run check:scripts
scripts.release: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' test && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --access public
